_comment: State of each quality gate (harness/core/docs/design.md, section 4). active - runs and shows its result; in_progress - being built, shown with its reason; disabled - switched off as a conscious trade-off, shown with its reason. check names a built-in check of harness/core/scripts/gates.py (hook_log, quality, preflight, deploy_report, snapshot, docs) or use command with any shell command. A gate moves to active in the same change that wires it.
